Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Montana Saphir robot stone grind structure (linear/cross hatch), ceramic disk edge finish (0.75° base / 2° side), minor P-Tex fill, IR wax.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Matches website ($65 CAD). Restores glide speed and silky turn initiation. 100% satisfaction guaranteed.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Machine ceramic edge sharpening, hand iron hot wax, scraped and horsehair brushed for maximum glide.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Matches website ($45 CAD). Restores sharp edge grip on cold hardpack and morning snow.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Infrared thermal wax iron application, scrape, rotary nylon & horsehair brush polish done while you wait.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Matches website ($25 CAD). Ready before morning coffee finishes brewing.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Waxelator infrared heating lamp drives micro-crystalline wax deep into base pores without contact heat shock.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Lasts 3x longer than traditional hand wax. Ideal for dry Okanagan cold smoke powder.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Service Name: World Cup Hand Prep & Race Tune
Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Precision base flattening, custom laser structure pattern, hand-filed 0.5°/3° bevels, gummy stone polish, double cold IR wax cycle.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Performed by Master Bootfitter/Technician. Requires 24-hr base curing.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Service Name: Ski / Snowboard Binding Mount & DIN Test
Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Professional jig drilling, waterproof resin mounting, DIN torque calibration on computerized Montana tester.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: COMPLIMENTARY with purchase of new skis/board and bindings at our shop.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Remove old bindings, tap and insert color-matched watertight nylon plugs, drill new pattern, DIN safety certification.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Requires minimum 15mm clearance from previous binding hole pattern.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Service Name: Core Shot & Base Delamination Epoxy Repair
Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Base excision, marine structural epoxy metal-grip bond, P-Tex weld patch, stone leveled to flush finish.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Priced at $45 base plus $15 per additional inch of damage beyond 2 inches.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Service Name: Custom Boot Shell Punch / Stretch (Per Zone)
Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Infrared localized heating of boot shell, hydraulic ball/ring press to relieve 6th-toe, navicular, or ankle pressure.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Includes 14-Day Custom Boot Comfort Guarantee. Free adjustments if work done on boots purchased in-store.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Heated vacuum casting pod molds 100% bespoke high-density arch support under guest feet. Prevents foot collapse.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Guarantees reduced foot fatigue, improved heel lock, and 20% sharper edge control response.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Jumps the queue ahead of overnight production queue. Dedicated master tech allocated immediately.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Subject to workshop machine availability during peak holidays.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Full drivetrain ultrasonic degrease and lube, shifting calibration, wheel truing, headset adjustment, rotor deglazing, safety bolt torque check.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Ensures crisp shifting and quiet mountain trail operation. Certified mechanics.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Service Name: Basic Bike Safety Check, Shift & Brake Tune
Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Brakes inspected and centered, cables adjusted, chain wiped and lubed, tires inflated to optimal terrain pressure.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Recommended tune-up before weekend trail rides or valley cruises.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Complete fluid replacement with fresh Shimano Mineral Oil or SRAM DOT fluid, air bubbles expelled, caliper piston reset.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Restores firm lever feel and full stopping power on steep alpine descents.

Workshop_Services_Menu.Service Name: Tubeless Tire Setup & Sealant Refresh (Per Wheel)
Workshop_Services_Menu.Technical Process & Inclusions: Stan's NoTubes sealant injection, rim tape inspection, valve core clean/replace, high-pressure bead seating.
Workshop_Services_Menu.Guarantee & Safety Policy: Prevents trail pinch flats and thorn punctures. Guaranteed airtight seal.

Tours_and_Experiences.Cold Weather & Weather Policy: Runs down to -25°C. Heated handlebars, FXR thermal suits and dual-pane modular helmets provided free.

Tours_and_Experiences.Cold Weather & Weather Policy: Tours run down to -25°C. In heavy blizzard, route moves to sheltered cedar grove.

Tours_and_Experiences.Gear & Inclusions: Tubbs snowshoes, trekking poles, high-power LED headlamps, local Swiss-style three-cheese fondue & Okanagan wine.

Tours_and_Experiences.Experience Name: Avalanche Canada AST-1 Field Course & Cert

Tours_and_Experiences.Escalation / Handoff Trigger: Bot must NEVER provide personalized safety clearance or avalanche route assessment. Safety escalation.

Tours_and_Experiences.Cold Weather & Weather Policy: If AQHI >= 7 or heavy rain, free reschedule. Layers recommended for lake breeze.

Tours_and_Experiences.Gear & Inclusions: Specialized Turbo Vado E-Bike, helmet, pannier, tastings at 3 partner lakeside wineries, gourmet lunch box.

Tours_and_Experiences.Experience Name: Guided Alpine Singletrack Enduro MTB Tour
Tours_and_Experiences.Cold Weather & Weather Policy: Runs in light rain; severe lightning or AQHI >= 7 triggers free reschedule or full credit.
Tours_and_Experiences.Escalation / Handoff Trigger: Private custom groups of 6+ or technical downhill coaching require manager booking.
Tours_and_Experiences.Gear & Inclusions: PMBIA certified guide, shuttle van access to alpine trailhead, trail pass, spare tubes and pump support.

Tours_and_Experiences.Experience Name: Okanagan Valley Fall Colors & Ridge Photography Hike
Tours_and_Experiences.Cold Weather & Weather Policy: Runs in all autumn weather except high gale winds. Warm layers and sturdy footwear recommended.
Tours_and_Experiences.Escalation / Handoff Trigger: Groups of 10+ or special photo workshop requests require manager booking.
Tours_and_Experiences.Gear & Inclusions: Certified naturalist guide, carbon trekking poles, local orchard hot apple cider and fresh artisanal pastries.
